A1.justification: Both complete, readable 20-page PDFs describe the same work, renamed from SPECTRE to PARASITE. The methods, experiments, figures, tables, equations, and appendices can be matched reliably.

before.justification: v3 reports original TriviaQA and TruthfulQA experiments, commercial-API evaluations, ablations, defense tests, and qualitative examples.

after.justification: v4 retains these original empirical results and adds results for strong system-prompt paraphrasing as a defense.

M1.justification: The two-stage AAP initialization and greedy lexical refinement, objectives, transformations, and Algorithm 1 remain unchanged. Section 4.1 clarifies the existing F1-threshold indicator; the framework rename and additional defense experiment do not establish an attack-method change.

E1.justification: TriviaQA, TruthfulQA, their domains, and answer formats are retained. Section 8 adds evaluation with strongly paraphrased system prompts, extending the tested input conditions beyond typo polishing. The proposed RAG extension remains future work, without evaluation.

E2.justification: Figure 8 adds GPT-4o-mini strong paraphrasing as a defense comparator alongside the original prompts and polishing. Manual, NSP, AAP, and ECLIPSE participation in the existing attack comparisons is unchanged; newly cited TrojLLM and Virtual Prompt Injection are not evaluated.

E3.justification: The added defense protocol rewrites system-prompt wording and sentence structure while preserving directives before evaluating DeepSeek-7B and Qwen2.5-7B across three answer formats. Existing splits, metrics, budgets, and model configurations are unchanged. Sanitizer temperature is newly disclosed rather than demonstrably revised.

E4.justification: Section 8 extends the sanitization robustness analysis from grammar and typo correction to strong paraphrasing, testing whether broader rewriting disrupts the attack. Existing threshold, initialization, model-size, and typo-removal ablations and qualitative cases are retained.

E5.justification: Statistical reporting practices are unchanged. Existing shaded plots are retained, while the added paraphrasing results introduce no repeated-run counts, seeds, confidence intervals, significance tests, or uncertainty-estimation procedures.

E6.justification: Tables 2–5 and the matched appendix result tables are numerically unchanged. Figure 8 adds paraphrasing results, including Qwen2.5 malicious F1 of 64.3, 62.6, and 58.4 for two-option, four-option, and FreeForm tasks. New Table 6 mostly repeats Table 5 values under different model labels, leaving its intended attribution unclear.

T1.justification: The objectives, constraints, and importance-score equations remain unchanged. The new piecewise indicator in Section 4.1 spells out the F1 > 0.5 condition already mentioned in v3; it does not introduce different mathematical reasoning or a new formal result.

C1.justification: The abstract and principal contributions retain the same selective-poisoning, black-box optimization, effectiveness, and stealth claims. The conclusion adds a limited applicability claim that the framework can be repurposed for RAG poisoning, explicitly leaving this extension to future work.

C2.justification: v4 extends the semantic-steering interpretation and claimed sanitization-versus-utility tension to strong paraphrasing. However, its new claim that Qwen2.5 FreeForm benign F1 falls to 22.8 conflicts with Figure 8, which shows 44.0. The enumerated limitations remain unchanged.

D1.justification: New Appendix C specifies sanitizer temperature=0, processing of the entire system prompt, and the exact strong-paraphrasing instructions. The polishing prompt is retained from v3 Table A15. v4 also clarifies token-level threshold scoring and updates the advertised repository address from CAIN to PARASITE.

R1.justification: Section 2 adds TrojLLM and Virtual Prompt Injection, distinguishing their user-query triggers and training-data poisoning from inference-time system-prompt poisoning. This is a focused positioning expansion; the existing related-work discussion and appendix taxonomy otherwise remain.

P1.justification: v4 renames the framework, edits terminology and grammar, updates author information, adds acknowledgements, and expands selected explanations. A dedicated sanitization appendix shifts the later appendix labels, while the overall narrative and main section order remain intact.

P2.justification: Figure 8 gains paraphrasing bars and a revised legend and caption. v4 adds Table 6 and the strong-paraphrasing prompt table, relocates the existing polishing prompt, and reflows appendix tables. Most existing visualizations and table structures are retained.

improvement.justification: The added defense experiment, sanitizer details, and related-work distinctions provide useful evidence and clarity. However, new reporting problems undermine their benefit: Section 8 claims paraphrasing reduces Qwen2.5 FreeForm benign F1 to 22.8, whereas Figure 8 shows 44.0; Table 6 mixes DeepSeek/Qwen labels with an OpenAI-API caption and largely repeats Table 5. These unresolved inconsistencies affect the new defense interpretation and prevent a confident net quality judgment.
